jobs: one task per GPU; six concurrent tasks on physical GPUs 0-5; GPUs 6-7 excluded
timer: sum of all 80 epoch train_validation_seconds; CUDA synchronize before time.perf_counter start and after complete validation prediction and CPU metrics
included: training batch collation and device transfers
complete validation data handling, prediction, and CPU metrics
allocated_memory: torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats(device) after model/optimizer setup; maximum torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(device) sampled after each training/validation epoch; divided by 1024**2; includes already live device tensors and framework allocations; excludes other processes, caching-reserved but unallocated memory, and device total
